title: credential-ages/1: each secret the Factory stores, by its name alone, never its value: what it is, where it is stored, the workflow files that name it, and the dates its age and limit are read from (L-37, issue 305). A credential's limit is the earlier of its expiry and its last rotation plus its period; one within `due_within_days` of it raises the one alert `credential_due`. The Maintainer updates a row by pull request at each rotation.

due_within_days.description: How near its limit a credential raises the alert, in days

secret.description: The secret's name, as a workflow names it

kind.description: What it can do: `write` on GitHub, `model` capacity, `read` alone; or `coordinate`, a value kept secret so that a log masks it, which is no credential and has no age

environment.description: The environment it is stored in; null for a secret stored elsewhere, and for an App's key, whose environment `config/apps.json` alone holds (decision 0009)

workflows.description: The files under .github/workflows/ that name it, and no other does; none while the workflow that will is not built

rotated_on.description: The day it was last set, read from GitHub's `updated_at` for the secret, its name and time alone: read for a period, and otherwise the record of a rotation; null for a coordinate

expires.description: Whether it expires; one that does and whose `expires_on` is not given is due

expires_on.description: The day it expires; null where it does not, and where it does until the Maintainer gives the day, which is due

rotate_every_days.description: Its rotation period; null where it has none, which is every credential today: the Maintainer chose expiry alone (2026-10-29)
